description: List CRM users with optional filters for location, company, role, and sorting.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

ids.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to retrieve

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

role.description: Filter by user role (admin, user, etc.)

name: crm_list_users
